versions.content: Memory overflow indication Description: For each Event Memory it shall be indicated if the related event memory (e.g. primary and user defined memories) is full and the next event occurs to be stored in this event memory. Rationale: The information that an event memory overflow occurred is very important for fault analysis. Use Case: • Triggering further internal behavior (e.g displacement strategies) • Linking this information to a dedicated Extended Data Record • Vendor specific UDS-Service AppliesTo: CP, AP Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
